topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Finding out that my friend has been lying about their job was a hard pill to swallow, but I knew the path forward. I decided to meet them where they felt safe, under the old oak by the river, a place we've shared countless conversations. I didn't want to confront them with anger; instead, I tried to understand why they felt the need to fabricate. Listening to them, I realized how much pressure they felt to succeed, to fit in. I reassured them that their worth isn’t tied to a job title or a paycheck. We all have our battles, and sometimes, in the quiet moments, that’s where the real strength shows. I told them, no matter what, I’d be there, not just as a friend, but as someone who believes in them.
